domain: Poland round 2 — overhead, packaging, logistics multipliers and bought-in service prices

items.basis: IRU / Upply / Ti European Road Freight Rate Benchmark, Warsaw–Duisburg contract rate €1.45/km (spot €1.51/km), reported mid-2026 (context points to Q2 2026; snippet does not name the quarter). €1.45 × 4.374 = 6.342 PLN/km; spot €1.51 × 4.374 = 6.605 PLN/km. Earlier baseline Q4 2025: contract €1.37/km (5.99 PLN/km), spot €1.30/km. Lane is Polish-origin cross-border into Germany — the closest published proxy for a Poland-registered carrier rate.
items.date: 2026-06/07 (Q2 2026 benchmark, as reported); Q4 2025 baseline from https://trans.info/en/spot-market-rates-452683
items.notes: Benchmark (market rate survey: IRU/Upply/Ti), read from search-result snippets — trans.info and ti-insight.com could not be fetched from this environment (egress blocked), so the figure was not read on the page itself. Ex-VAT (B2B international transport). Q2 2026 rise is fuel-driven (EU diesel €1.94/l avg Q2, +27% y/y) and the Polish e-toll rose ~33–42% from 1 Feb 2026.

items.basis: Same IRU/Upply/Ti Q2 2026 benchmark: Duisburg–Lille €2.58/km × 4.374 = 11.285 PLN/km; Duisburg–Prague €1.73/km × 4.374 = 7.567 PLN/km.
items.notes: Benchmark, from search snippets. Shows a Polish-origin lane (€1.45) at ~0.56× a West-European lane (€2.58).

items.unit: PLN per FTL load (~750 km PL→DE)
items.basis: Transporeon spot data cited in a newsletter: Poland→Germany ~€975 per load for a ~750 km run (Germany→Poland ~€744). €975 × 4.374 = 4,264.7 PLN; €975 ÷ 750 km = €1.30/km, consistent with the benchmark's €1.30–1.51/km Polish-lane range. Cross-check with the benchmark: a ~750 km Wrocław→Stuttgart-type run × €1.45/km ≈ €1,088 (4,758 PLN) — the 750 km is the newsletter's distance, not a measured Wrocław–Stuttgart distance.
items.notes: Spot snapshot (transaction-platform data) via a newsletter, undated — indicative only. No Wrocław→Stuttgart / Wolfsburg lane price was found.

items.basis: NOT SUPPORTED for the multiplier as defined. Per km, the evidence points the other way: Polish-origin lane €1.45/km v Duisburg–Lille €2.58/km = 0.56; v Paris–Birmingham €3.00/km = 0.48 (cross-Channel, so overstates UK). A per-part multiplier of 1.20 can only hold if the Polish supplier's lane to its OEM is ≥ 1.20 ÷ 0.48–0.56 ≈ 2.1–2.5× the UK supplier's lane length — plausible for PL→German OEM (500–800 km) v UK domestic supply (no sourced UK lane length found), but that is a distance assumption, not a researched figure.
items.notes: Keep 1.20 labelled as an unresearched assumption; if the tool's logistics £/part is per km, Poland should be < 1.0.

items.basis: Fastmarkets: unbleached kraftliner 170 g dap Poland €850–880/t in June (year not stated in the snippet; launch context suggests 2025). €850 × 4.374 = 3,718 PLN; €880 × 4.374 = 3,849 PLN; midpoint €865 × 4.374 = 3,784 PLN/t.
items.notes: Price-agency assessment, headline only. No matching UK containerboard or corrugated-box price was found, so no PL/UK paper ratio.

items.unit: PLN/m² ex-VAT (raw steel, single coat, job shop)
items.basis: kb.pl 2026 town price lists (estimates compiled from online offers, column marked brutto): raw steel (stal surowa) Ruda Śląska 58.50–63.20, Piekary Śląskie 56.70–61.30, Wodzisław Śląski 61.80–66.70 (Silesia); Ząbkowice Śląskie 61.20–66.10, Środa Śląska 57.20–61.70 (Lower Silesia) zł/m² gross. Mean low 295.4/5 = 59.08, mean high 319.0/5 = 63.80 gross; ÷ 1.23 = 48.03–51.87 ex-VAT, midpoint ≈ 50.0 PLN/m². Primer + colour, Śląskie voivodeship: 96.80–105 gross ÷ 1.23 = 78.70–85.37 ex-VAT.
items.notes: Aggregator estimates of job-shop / small-order prices (site states they are not a commercial offer) — NOT an automotive volume line price; read from search snippets. Gross/net basis taken from the snippet's 'brutto w zł/m2' header. Use as an upper cross-check. No UK £/m² price found → no ratio. Other towns (primer+colour): Warszawa 113–122, Gdańsk 99.70–108, Police 93.80–101 zł/m² gross (https://kb.pl/cenniki/miejskie/malowanie-proszkowe-_mot/warszawa/).

items.unit: PLN/m² ex-VAT (sandblasting of metal parts, job shop)
items.basis: kb.pl 2026 Lower Silesia table: piaskowanie elementów metalowych ~59–67 zł/m² gross (e.g. Bolesławiec 62.90, Dzierżoniów 66.50). ÷ 1.23 = 47.97–54.47 ex-VAT, midpoint 51.2 PLN/m².
items.notes: Aggregator estimate, sandblasting (not shot blasting / śrutowanie, which is usually priced per kg for castings and forgings) — cross-check only. No śrutowanie zł/kg price list found. No UK price found.

notes: Environment: WebFetch / curl to trans.info, ti-insight.com, stat.gov.pl, ons.gov.uk, upply.com, rha.uk.net were all denied by the egress proxy, so every figure here was read from search-result snippets, not from the page. Treat as 'reported by', and re-read on the page before it sets a rate.
FX per RULES.md: €1 = 4.374 PLN, £1 = 5.096 PLN. All PLN service prices converted from gross at 23% VAT.

None of the three multipliers (overhead 0.85, packaging 0.90, logistics 1.20) can be confirmed from sources found; the only quantified evidence (per-km freight) suggests a Polish carrier is ~0.5–0.56× a Western lane per km, so a logistics multiplier > 1 rests entirely on longer supplier→OEM distances.

Service prices found (powder coat ~50 PLN/m², sandblast ~51 PLN/m² ex-VAT) are aggregator job-shop estimates, not automotive volume prices; heat treatment, NDT, galvanising and anodising were not found. 29 web searches used.
